mapper.sql: rating_id, user_id, poem_id, score, rated_at AS rating_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO poem_rating (user_id, poem_id, score) VALUES (#{userId}, #{poemId}, #{score}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE score = #{score}, rated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM poem_rating WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND poem_id = #{poemId}
